# Atlantic Flagpole
> Premium telescoping flagpoles for residential and commercial properties across the United States. American-made quality, engineered to last.

Atlantic Flagpole sells and installs high-performance telescoping flagpoles designed for homes, businesses, and institutions. Products are wind-rated up to 100 mph, made from anodized aluminum, and ship nationwide. Based in the Carolinas, serving all 50 states.

## Products

- [All Flagpoles](https://atlanticflagpole.com/flagpoles): Browse the full line of telescoping flagpoles — residential and commercial grades in silver and bronze anodized aluminum
- [Accessories](https://atlanticflagpole.com/accessories): Flags, mounting hardware, duo harness systems, swivel rings, and installation kits
- [All Products](https://atlanticflagpole.com/collections/all): Complete product catalog

## Flagship Products

- Phoenix Telescoping Flagpole (20ft & 25ft): Available in silver and dark bronze anodized aluminum. 100 mph wind-rated, Securi-Lok interlocking sleeve system, 360° swivel rings, and duo harness for flying two flags simultaneously.
- Phoenix Premier Kit: Complete installation kit including flagpole, hardware, and flags — everything needed for a professional residential installation.

## Company

- [Our Story](https://atlanticflagpole.com/our-story): The history and mission behind Atlantic Flagpole — built on craftsmanship and American values

## Key Facts

- Ships nationwide from the Carolinas
- Wind-rated up to 100 mph
- Anodized aluminum — won't rust, won't fade
- Telescoping design — no ropes, no pulleys, no noise
- Duo harness system supports two flags simultaneously
- 360° swivel rings eliminate flag wrap
- Used by homeowners, businesses, churches, and municipalities
